description:
Design a 15mm bicycle cone wrench in FreeCAD. 

Goal: Create a single solid 3D model of a wrench with the following specific dimensions:
1. Head: A circular profile with a diameter of 32 mm, centered at the Origin.
2. Handle: A rectangular strip 12 mm wide and at least 100 mm long, extending along the X-axis from the head.
3. Jaw Cutout: A slot with a width of exactly 15.0 mm. The slot must be angled at 15 degrees relative to the handle/X-axis. The bottom of the slot (throat) should be approximately 8 mm from the center of the head.
4. Thickness: Extrude the entire profile to exactly 2.0 mm.

Save the completed design as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/cone_wrench.FCStd'.
